draft_text: Under 10% label noise, Thornbill-NER's F1 dropped by only 0.6 points, within the pre-specified robustness criterion.
rationale: The package only reports original-label results (T1) and defines the robustness criterion, but contains no label-noise perturbation experiments, no 10% noise condition, and no 0.6-point drop. The cited T2.r1.f1 does not exist. The claim is entirely unsupported.
